criteria.evidence: No /change-review skill existed; user redirected to /code-review and the replay ran it twice sequentially ('First pass fixed. Running /code-review a second time on the updated diff.').
Pass 1 found two bugs (fixed with try/catch and pr.auto_merge short-circuit); pass 2 found two cleanup items (fixed by extraction and comment correction).
Committed as 5caac87 then d261f31 on the branch; push attempted and reported impossible due to no remote, which is expected in this environment.
Diff adds script/enableAutoMerge.js and the workflow step now contains only `const script = require('./script/enableAutoMerge.js'); await script({ core, context, github })`.

Replay diff hunk starts at line 479 (`@@ -479,36 +479,5 @@`); the 14-line comment block above the step (lines 460-473, 'Enabling auto-merge here is NOT merging on green...') is untouched and still present.

Script remains one flat anonymous function with nested try/catch and an inline GraphQL string; no named helpers or structure express the steps — the replay only trimmed one comment rather than restructuring.
Three remaining comments each state a non-obvious reason (best-effort/never throw, base.sha staleness, updateBranch asynchrony).

Extracted script keeps pulls.get -> compareCommitsWithBasehead -> updateBranch -> enablePullRequestAutoMerge in order, best-effort warnings, and PR_NUMBER from process.env; the extra guards came from the mandated code-review fixes rather than the extraction.
Replay only ran node/YAML syntax checks; never ran or mentioned `gx lint` or `openspec validate --strict`.

judge.reason: The replay extracted the script and committed, but the final diff shows the verbose comment block on the auto-merge step was never removed (hunk begins at line 479, leaving lines 460-473 intact), and the script was not restructured so the 'what' is carried by naming/structure. It also never ran the repository's gx lint or openspec validate checks.
